title: Juicy Velvety Canadian Thai Eggplant Bowl
description: A vegetarian dish featuring Thai eggplant and Canadian flavors, with a velvety texture and energizing taste. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Thai eggplant into 1-inch pieces and place them in the air fryer basket.
Drizzle the canola oil over the eggplant and cook for 10 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of canola oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, maple syrup, and rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the onion and garlic mixture and bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked eggplant to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the eggplant mixture over cooked rice or noodles.
